svg.aria-label: Forward and right shift by the estimate against time for each session 3 take-off
svg.text: Sideways shift by the estimate, from when flow arrives
Forward is the way the drone faced at take-off; right is to its right. Lines end at touchdown or where the log stops (the tick loop's end). Below 0.1 m the estimate overstates speed.
Failsafe low 1 and 2 (unlabeled) end at their faults. Hover and TOS 5b: no estimate in their landings.
